name: Lion Travel Service Co., Ltd.
summary: Lion Travel Service Co., Ltd., founded in 1977 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, delivers a comprehensive array of travel solutions to clients both domestically and internationally. Its primary services include organized tour packages, transportation ticketing, assistance with visa applications, and professional tour guiding, alongside various other travel-related provisions. Beyond its core travel business, the company also operates in the fields of information technology, management consulting, and catering.
